jobs.title: Private Banking Key Clients Portfolio Manager (4348)
jobs.description:
* Develop and leverage an in depth understanding of Key clients’ needs within the private banking by assessing customer needs and conducting customer surveys to be able to provide high competitive range of product and service


* Build and lead a best in class customer experience, demonstrating the ability to understand the technical, social and emotional values that have critical business significance.


* Market the full range of products \& service to Private Banking clients’ segmentation and contribute effectively in achieving the Private Banking budget while identifying and meeting customer needs


* Manage and increase the portfolio by acquiring NTB private banking customers and cross sell EG\-Bank services and products to existing and prospective customers


* Handling all Private Banking customers’ inquiries and complaints and ensure resolving them efficiently within the set TAT while delivering a consistent and tailored private management service to Private Banking clients and developing a long term, in depth client relationship.


* Analyze portfolio performance statistics to better understand customer behavior and plan for future activities with a continuous focus towards helping the client to adapt to changes in personal circumstances and financial environment


* Review daily inflows/outflows of the assigned portfolio to retain clients and avoid losing funds


* Respond positively and diligently to colleagues and coordinate and communicate effectively with the Branches and support units to ensure that customers’ requests are processed timely and effectively.


* Follows all relevant approved department’s policies, and procedures and monitors adherence so that work is carried out in a controlled manner.


* Follow the day\-to\-day operations related to own jobs in the Private Banking department and assigned Branch to ensure continuity of work.


* Comply with all relevant CBE regulations, banking laws, AML regulations and internal EG Bank policies and code of conduct to maintain EG Bank’s sound legal position and mitigate any potential risks .


* **Qualifications and Experience:**


	+ Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Accounting or its equivalence.
	+ 6 to 8 years of experience in any retail field preferred exposure with portfolio management
	+ Proven record of building relationships and closing business
	+ Successful track record of sales and aggressive targets achievements
	+ Experience in Retail \& Customer Service areas is a must.**Skills:**


	+ Excellent writing, communication and presentation skills.
	+ Strong Analytical and Numerical Skills.
	+ Strong Interpersonal, communication and networking skills
	+ Self\-driven and results oriented with a positive outlook and clear focus on delivering results.
	+ Good leadership skills.
	+ Sales \& Target Oriented.
	+ Well organized, accurate, self\-driven, problem solver and has the ability to work under stress \& pressure.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst- FP&A
jobs.description:
**Shape \& Create \- And make it happen!**
==========================================

**The Villeroy \& Boch Group with its Ideal Standard brand is one of the world's leading manufacturers in the ceramics and lifestyle sector. With our innovative and stylish products from the Dining \& Lifestyle and Bath \& Wellness segments, we have been creating moments and rooms to feel good in since 1748\. Our success is based on the passion, design expertise and innovative strength of our more than 13,000 employees in 42 countries.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Want to become part of us? \#shapeandcreate**
-----------------------------------------------


Your Role

* Consolidate, analyze, and report financial data, ensuring alignment with company objectives.
* Support monthly financial reporting, analysis, forecasting, and the annual budgeting process.
* Develop financial models, conduct benchmarking, and perform process analysis.
* Prepare monthly statements, investigate variances, and track financial performance against forecasts.
* Reconcile transactions, correct discrepancies, and assist with month\- and year\-end accounting close.
* Analyze business unit performance, identify key variance drivers, and monitor financial metrics.
* Develop rolling forecasts (revenues, expenses, P\&L, balance sheet, cash flow) and conduct business studies.
* Coordinate with external auditors for year\-end closing.
* Performing other duties as assigned


Your Profile:

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting/finance.
* The ability to communicate in English fluently.
* 3\+ years of experience in Finance (Financial Analysis).
* Exposure to financial analysis, operations analysis, financial reporting, and internal controls is a significant asset.
* Financial Skills, Forecasting, Financial Diagnosis, Analyzing Information, Financial Planning and Strategy, corporate finance, and information.
* Big 4 Audit firm experience (PWC, Deloitte, E\&Y, KPMG) is an asset
* Proficient in spreadsheets, databases, MS Office, and financial applications.
* Hands on experience with statistical analysis and statistical packages
* Outstanding presentation, reporting and communications skills
* SAP user is preferred.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Experienced team player.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities and manage deadlines.
* Ability to work well under pressure.
* Demonstrated strong project management skills.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.

**Think outside the box with us! \#shapeandcreate**
===================================================
